parsed.explanation: The objection identifies a genuine gap: inserting c changes the branch, so dispensability on that modified branch does not contradict the pruning of the original branch. Indeed, the stated finite-transversal lemma is false for general pairwise-intersecting families, as the ledger’s family F_k illustrates. No other passage proves large-prime erasure or finite dependence for all terms; the later periodicity argument relies entirely on this invalid lemma. Repair therefore requires a substantive replacement lemma establishing L6.2.
